protocol: Run each language prompt in a fresh Codex and Claude Code session with only the installed plugin and stated consumer context. Do not supply the expected observations to the acting model. Capture host/model/plugin versions, selected skill, tool trace, diff, resolved graph, and consumer build/test result. Assess behavior, not matching phrases. The fixture tests validate library examples, not these AI behaviors.

cases.context: A new Swift 6.4 macOS 14 package, no other macro dependencies; network available.
cases.ko: InnoDI 7.0.0으로 APIClient를 주입하고 테스트에서는 fake로 바꿀 수 있게 구성해줘.
cases.en: Use InnoDI 7.0.0 to inject an APIClient and replace it with a fake in tests.
observe: Selects innodi
Uses the released version and verifies resolution
Attaches DAG plugin to the declaring target
Generated consumer compiles and override avoids live construction

cases.context: Use a copy of assets/consumer with its exact lock file. AppServices.label already counts factory calls.
cases.ko: 이 컨테이너의 label을 미리 준비하되 빈 prewarm 호출은 아무것도 만들지 않는지 테스트를 추가해줘.
cases.en: Add a test that prewarms this container's label but proves an empty prewarm call constructs nothing.
observe: Recognizes existing InnoDI without library name in prompt
Uses nonthrowing typed selections
Checks factory count and shared copy behavior

cases.context: A SwiftUI project explicitly using Factory, without InnoDI or migration request.
cases.ko: Factory는 그대로 두고 이 화면의 버튼 간격만 조정해줘.
cases.en: Keep Factory as it is and only adjust this screen's button spacing.
observe: Does not introduce InnoDI or convert dependency injection
Changes only the requested UI spacing

cases.context: Consumer pinned to InnoDI 6.0.0, exact source available.
cases.ko: 버전은 유지하면서 이 테스트의 서비스 override를 수정해줘.
cases.en: Fix the service override in this test while keeping the dependency version unchanged.
observe: Reads actual 6.0 source
Does not use 7.0-only APIs or upgrade the lock file
Builds against the existing version

cases.context: Use assets/consumer SessionLoader with failFirst enabled.
cases.ko: 세션 준비 실패를 보여주고 사용자가 재시도할 때 한 번만 다시 준비하도록 만들어줘. 화면 종료 때 정리해줘.
cases.en: Show session preparation failure, retry once when the user requests it, and clean up when the feature ends.
observe: Does not treat makeOwned as readiness
Checks preparation or uses requireReady
Explicit retry is bounded
Closes on the real feature lifecycle boundary

cases.context: Use the gated SessionLoader and a shared on-demand session in assets/consumer.
cases.ko: 한 대기자가 취소돼도 다른 대기자가 같은 세션 결과를 받는지 검증해줘.
cases.en: Verify that cancelling one reader lets another reader receive the same shared session result.
observe: Uses deterministic synchronization instead of arbitrary sleeps
Does not cancel or retry the provider when only a reader cancels
One factory attempt supplies the remaining reader

cases.context: AppServices.label is String? with a counted live factory, as in assets/consumer.
cases.ko: 테스트에서 label을 명시적으로 nil로 바꾸고 live factory가 호출되지 않는지 확인해줘.
cases.en: Override label with an explicit nil in the test and prove the live factory never runs.
observe: Uses set(_:to:) for explicit nil
Distinguishes nil payload from unset/default
Checks returned nil and zero live calls

cases.context: A 6.0.0 consumer with named parent paths, throwing key-path prewarm, and an InnoDISwiftUI import; preserve an unrelated dirty file.
cases.ko: 7.0으로 올려줘. 마이그레이터가 하지 못하는 부분도 구분해서 수정해줘.
cases.en: Upgrade to 7.0 and distinguish the changes the migrator cannot perform automatically.
observe: Runs check before scoped write
Manually handles typed prewarm and deployment/Observation changes where present
Does not guess module trust or adopt ownership indiscriminately
Preserves unrelated dirty work
Builds the changed consumer

cases.context: A package pinned to InnoFlow 5.1.1 whose manifest requires SwiftSyntax below 604.0.0.
cases.ko: 이 앱에 InnoDI 7.0.0을 추가할 수 있는지 확인해줘. 기존 버전은 유지해줘.
cases.en: Check whether this app can add InnoDI 7.0.0 while keeping existing dependency versions.
observe: Identifies disjoint SwiftSyntax requirements from actual manifests
Does not silently downgrade or override sources
Does not claim Xcode upgrade resolves version constraints
Reports incompatibility and concrete options

cases.context: A copy of assets/consumer with the plugin removed from its declaring target. This minimal consumer can still compile; assess required validation configuration rather than assuming a compiler failure.
cases.ko: 이 컨테이너의 필수 DAG 검증 설정을 확인하고 빠진 구성이 있으면 고쳐줘.
cases.en: Check this container target for the required DAG validation configuration and fix any missing setup.
observe: Checks plugin attachment on the affected target
Restores validation instead of validateDAG:false
Does not invent a compiler failure
Preserves release pins and verifies the consumer under its original concurrency and warning settings
